This plot is small, only a quarter hectare, and I am growing beans on it. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they fix their own nitrogen in the soil, so I save my fertilizer for my maize plots where I really need it. I will put some manure from my goats on this plot before planting because the soil here is tired from last season, and I will use seed I saved from last year's harvest since the improved bean seed at the agro-dealer is expensive and my own seed gave me a decent harvest. The plot is small enough that me and my wife can handle the weeding and harvesting ourselves without paying anyone.
